03Our Audience

Who are we designing for?

The German market

Our audience was primarily homeowners aged 40+, still early in their solar journey.

Key insight

Interest was there. Confidence wasn't.

07Design Decisions

A simpler path to a smarter estimate.

We redesigned the experience around three principles: automate what we can, ask only what's easy to answer, and make the value clear.

Let the system find the data.

We use the customer's location to retrieve key details about their home upfront, so there's less to type and fewer questions to answer.

Fewer inputs. Fewer unnecessary questions.

Before

Manual input

  • Roof size?
  • Roof inclination?
  • Sunlight exposure?
After

We found your roof

  • Roof size
  • Roof inclination
  • Sunlight exposure

Ask what people can answer easily.

We reduced the number of questions and focused on the basics — things people know about their home.

A shorter, simpler form leads to higher completion rates.

Before

Asked for hard-to-find information

What is your average annual electricity consumption?

3,000kWh / year

iYou can find this on your electricity bill.

After

Ask what people can answer easily

How many people live in your home?

(Children count as one person)

3 people (ca. 3000 kWh)

Show the value, not just the calculation.

We visualized the customer's home and showed what the system could include — solar panels, battery storage, and other options.

A clear view of the value makes the decision easier.

Before

Only a cost estimate

Your estimated solar system cost

€739/year

iThis is an estimate based on the information you provided.

After

A personalized solution for your home

Your potential savings

€739 / year

Based on your home, location and selected system.
